chip_tx.figures_effective: Income limit from Texas Works Handbook C-131.1 (Revision 26-2, effective April 1, 2026) with dollar figures dated March 1, 2026. HHSC CHIP page, read 2026-10-12.

description.note: Who qualifies, services, enrollment fee, copays and Medicaid Buy-In for Children come from the HHSC CHIP page. The 201% limit comes from C-131.1 (TA 84 is labelled CHIP). The 90-day wait and the rule that the child is ineligible for Children's Medicaid come from D-121. C-1150 defines TA 84 as coverage for children under 19 who are ineligible for Medicaid due to income.

eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: Column header in the C-131.1 table headed TA 41, TA 84 (CHIP), TA 85 (CHIP-P), TA 77 and TP 70; handbook section C-1150 defines TA 84 as CI - CHIP. Ceiling for CHIP; only children above the Children's Medicaid limit qualify. The HHSC CHIP page dollar table (family of one $2,622) is older than the handbook table (family of one $2,674).

eligibility.citizenship_required.evidence: a U.S. citizen or qualified non-citizen
eligibility.citizenship_required.note: Applies to the child who gets CHIP. Handbook section D-121 agrees: be a U.S. citizen or non-citizen with valid proof of immigration/alien status.

eligibility.age_max.note: Inclusive. Handbook section D-121 says be under age 19.

eligibility.requires_children.evidence: low-cost health care coverage to children whose families earn too much money
eligibility.requires_children.note: Coverage is for the child, so the household must include a child.

estimated_monthly_value_usd.note: null: the agency publishes no dollar value for CHIP coverage.

application_url.note: method: http (curl) and browser. The Apply for CHIP link on the HHSC CHIP page points here.

documents_needed.evidence: Last two pay stubs or paychecks, a statement from your employer or self-employment records.
documents_needed.note: From the CHIP or Children's Medicaid section (income, unpaid medical bills of the past three months, citizenship) plus the general Documents We May Need list (identity, immigration status, residence).

processing_time_days.evidence: 45th day after the file date for an application requesting health care for children.
processing_time_days.note: Deadline to send the notice of case action for a children's application; stored as 45 days.

childrens_medicaid_tx.figures_effective: Income limits from Texas Works Handbook C-131.1 (Revision 26-2, effective April 1, 2026) with dollar figures dated March 1, 2026. HHSC Children's Medicaid page, read 2026-10-12.

description.note: Eligibility, coverage, long-term services and the automatic CHIP check come from the HHSC Children's Medicaid page. The three age bands come from C-131.1 column headers: 198% FPL (TP 40, 42, 43, 36, 35, TA 74), 144% FPL (TP 48, 33, TA 75) and 133% FPL (TP 44, 34, TA 76), mapped to ages by A-240: TP 43 children under age 1, TP 48 ages 1 to 5, TP 44 ages 6 to 18.

eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: Highest band: children under 1 (TP 43, 198%, per handbook section A-240). Ages 1 to 5 (TP 48) 144%; ages 6 to 18 (TP 44) 133%. Every band is listed in the description. The HHSC page dollar table (family of one $1,735) is older than the handbook table (family of one $1,769 at 133%).

eligibility.citizenship_required.evidence: a U.S. citizen or qualified non-citizen
eligibility.citizenship_required.note: Applies to the child who gets Medicaid.

eligibility.age_max.note: Inclusive. The page adds that some children with disabilities aged 19 or 20 can get Medicaid; handbook section A-240 says children under age 19.

eligibility.requires_children.evidence: provides free health coverage for children in low-income families
eligibility.requires_children.note: Coverage is for the child, so the household must include a child.

estimated_monthly_value_usd.note: null: the agency publishes no dollar value for Children's Medicaid coverage.

application_url.note: method: http (curl) and browser. The Apply for Medicaid link on the HHSC page leads to Your Texas Benefits.

documents_needed.evidence: Last two pay stubs or paychecks, a statement from your employer or self-employment records.
documents_needed.note: From the CHIP or Children's Medicaid section (income, unpaid medical bills of the past three months, citizenship) plus the general Documents We May Need list (identity, immigration status, residence).

processing_time_days.evidence: including those with spend down by the 45th day from the file date.
processing_time_days.note: B-112 Deadlines, Medical Programs: notice of case action by the 45th day from the file date.

medicaid_pregnant_women_tx.figures_effective: Income limit from Texas Works Handbook C-131.1 (Revision 26-2, effective April 1, 2026) with dollar figures dated March 1, 2026. HHSC pregnant women page, read 2026-10-12.

description.note: Coverage period, residency, citizenship, benefits and the CHIP Perinatal fallback come from the HHSC page. The 198% limit and the $2,634 figure for one person come from C-131.1 and match the HHSC page table. The 15 business days and no-interview rule are in A-140. A-820 confirms continuous eligibility through the 12th month after the pregnancy ends.

eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: TP 40 is the pregnant women Medicaid type program (handbook sections A-240: minor or adult pregnant woman; C-1150: MA Pregnant Women). The same 198% column covers children under 1.

eligibility.citizenship_required.evidence: To get Medicaid, you must be a U.S. citizen or a qualified non-citizen.
eligibility.citizenship_required.note: Applies to the pregnant woman. Women who fail this test may qualify for CHIP Perinatal.

eligibility.requires_pregnancy.evidence: Medicaid gives health coverage to low-income pregnant women.

estimated_monthly_value_usd.note: null: the agency publishes no dollar value for this coverage.

application_url.note: method: http (curl) and browser. The Apply for Medicaid and CHIP Perinatal link on the HHSC page leads to Your Texas Benefits.

documents_needed.evidence: Two pay stubs or paychecks from the last 60 days
documents_needed.note: From the Medicaid for an Adult or Pregnant Woman section (income, unpaid medical bills of the past three months, citizenship) plus the general Documents We May Need list (identity, immigration status, residence).

processing_time_days.evidence: eligibility determined no later than 15 business days from the date HHSC receives the application
processing_time_days.note: Stored as 15, which the handbook states in business days (about 21 calendar days). Handbook section D-230 says the 15th working day after the file date for a pregnant woman's application.

chip_perinatal_tx.figures_effective: Income limit from Texas Works Handbook C-131.1 (Revision 26-2, effective April 1, 2026) with dollar figures dated March 1, 2026. HHSC CHIP Perinatal FAQs, read 2026-10-12.

description.note: Income paths, immigration-status path, benefits, no waiting period/fees/copays, documents and the 15 business days come from the CHIP Perinatal FAQs. 'No other health insurance', the two post-pregnancy visits and the pregnancy requirement are on the HHSC pregnant women page. The rule that a woman who applies after the baby is born is not eligible is D-122.1.

eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.evidence: household income up to 202% of the federal poverty level (FPL)
eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: Handbook section C-131.1 column header agrees: 202% FPL March 1, 2026 TA 85 (labelled CHIP-P).

eligibility.citizenship_required.evidence: but do not qualify for Medicaid because of immigration status
eligibility.citizenship_required.note: false: the program covers the unborn child of a woman who is ineligible for Medicaid or CHIP due to income or immigration status (handbook section C-1150, TA 85), so citizenship is not required.

eligibility.requires_pregnancy.evidence: CHIP Perinatal is for pregnant women who:
eligibility.requires_pregnancy.note: Pregnancy is required (handbook section D-122: be pregnant).

estimated_monthly_value_usd.note: null: the agency publishes no dollar value for this coverage.

application_url.note: method: http (curl) and browser. The FAQs say women can apply online at Your Texas Benefits.

documents_needed.evidence: A paycheck stub from the last 60 days
documents_needed.note: FAQ section 'What other documents do women need to send with their application?' lists proof of income and proof of expenses.

processing_time_days.evidence: staff have 15 business days to process the application from the day it is received
processing_time_days.note: Stored as 15, which the page states in business days (about 21 calendar days). Handbook section D-230: 15th working day.

emergency_medicaid_tx.figures_effective: Income limits from Texas Works Handbook C-131.1 (Revision 26-2, effective April 1, 2026) with dollar figures dated March 1, 2026.

description.note: Covered groups and immigration categories: A-242 (in A-240) and C-1150. Citizenship exception: A-310. Stabilization-only coverage and 12-month periods: A-820. Form H3038 and practitioner certification: the H3038 instructions page. Elderly and disabled adults: MEPD A-2200 (meet all SSI criteria except citizenship). Income bands: C-131.1 headers 198% (TP 40, 42, 43, 36, 35, TA 74), 144% (TP 48, 33, TA 75), 133% (TP 44, 34, TA 76); C-1150 defines TP 35 as children under 1 emergency, TP 36 as pregnant women emergency, TP 33 as children 1 to 5 emergency and TP 34 as children 6 to 18 emergency.

eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: Highest band, which covers TP 35 (children under 1 emergency) and TP 36 (pregnant women emergency) per handbook section C-1150. TP 33 (ages 1 to 5) is 144% and TP 34 (ages 6 to 18) is 133%. Elderly or disabled adults (TP 30) are tested against SSI criteria, not a poverty percentage.

eligibility.citizenship_required.evidence: Undocumented aliens applying for Emergency Medicaid do not have to meet citizenship status eligibility requirements.
eligibility.citizenship_required.note: false: Exception noted in A-310 General Policy. A-242 lists non-immigrants, undocumented aliens and certain legal permanent residents who do not meet citizenship rules as the certified group.

estimated_monthly_value_usd.note: null: the agency publishes no dollar value; coverage is for the emergency only.

application_url.note: method: http (curl) and browser. No consumer page for Emergency Medicaid was found; the Next Steps page says documents go to Your Texas Benefits, the HHSC application portal. Route flagged in the needs-human-check file.

documents_needed.evidence: Complete Form H3038 to verify a nonimmigrant, an undocumented alien
documents_needed.note: Form H3038 instructions (updated 1/2026) require the attending practitioner's handwritten signature. Other items are from the general Documents We May Need list on the HHSC Benefits Application Next Steps page.

processing_time_days.evidence: including those with spend down by the 45th day from the file date.
processing_time_days.note: B-112 Deadlines, Medical Programs: notice by the 45th day from the file date. Time spent obtaining Form H3038 is not counted.

medicaid_elderly_disabled_tx.figures_effective: Income and resource limits effective Jan. 1, 2026 (G-1300 Revision 26-1, Appendix XI dated 6-2026).

description.note: Who it serves, citizenship and covered services: HHSC MEPD page. 65 or older and the 45 and 90 day deadlines: B-6400. Social Security disability definition: D-1400. Dollar limits: G-1310 ($994 and $1,491), G-1320 ($2,982 and $5,964) and Appendix XI (resources $2,000 and $3,000).

eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: null: limits are published in dollars. The G-1300 introduction (Revision 12-4) mentions 300% of the federal poverty level but G-1320 on the same page defines the special limit as 300% of the SSI federal benefit rate ($2,982), so no percent of poverty is recorded.

eligibility.citizenship_required.evidence: you must be a Texas resident and a U.S. citizen or a qualified non-citizen

eligibility.age_min.note: null: age 65 or older is one of two alternative paths (the other is disability), so no single minimum age is recorded.

estimated_monthly_value_usd.note: null: the agency publishes no dollar value for MEPD coverage.

application_url.note: method: http (curl) and browser. The Apply for MEPD link on the HHSC page leads to Your Texas Benefits.

documents_needed.evidence: Resident card (I-551), arrival/departure form (I-94) or papers from United States Citizenship and Immigration Services.
documents_needed.note: General Documents We May Need list on the Next Steps page, which applies to any benefit program. No MEPD-specific section exists on that page.

processing_time_days.evidence: Make a decision within 90 days on applications from applicants who must have disability established
processing_time_days.note: Upper bound. 45 days applies to applicants 65 or older and to applicants whose disability is already established by Social Security criteria.

tanf_tx.figures_effective: HHSC TANF page read 2026-10-12; handbook C-111 budgetary allowances effective Oct. 1, 2026 (Revision 26-4).

description.note: Who it is for, what it offers, income and grant charts, program rules and One-Time TANF: HHSC TANF page. The $1,000 resource limit: A-1220. Grant range: the HHSC page Maximum Monthly TANF Amount chart (lowest $130, highest $545). The handbook C-111 table effective Oct. 1, 2026 has an empty Max Grant column, so the HHSC chart is the only published grant schedule read.

eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: null: TANF income limits are dollar amounts by family size (HHSC page chart; C-111 recognizable needs column, for example $78 for one caretaker case). The handbook tests budgetary and recognizable needs, not a percent of poverty.

eligibility.citizenship_required.evidence: U.S. citizens and certain legally-admitted alien residents are eligible for benefits
eligibility.citizenship_required.note: A-310 General Policy, All Programs. A-313: for TANF, a child without verified eligible alien status is ineligible.

eligibility.requires_children.evidence: Families with children ages 18 and younger.
eligibility.requires_children.note: Marked true from the HHSC page. No page read rules out an unborn-child-only path; flagged in the needs-human-check file.

estimated_monthly_value_usd.note: null: the agency publishes only a maximum grant schedule by family size and household type, not an average benefit.

application_url.note: method: http (curl) and browser. The TANF page says to apply at Your Texas Benefits.

documents_needed.evidence: Proof a child is related to you
documents_needed.note: From the TANF Cash Help section of the Next Steps page. Items for child support and health insurance apply only if relevant.

processing_time_days.evidence: by the 45th day after the file date.
processing_time_days.note: B-112 Deadlines, TANF and Medical Programs: notice of case action by the 45th day after the file date.

unemployment_benefits_tx.figures_effective: Weekly benefit amounts for claims starting October 4, 2026 (TWC table row).

description.note: Program definition and eligibility tests: TWC overview and Eligibility and Benefit Amounts pages. Weekly benefit range ($76 minimum and $619 maximum for October 4, 2026) and the 26 times / 27 percent cap: Eligibility and Benefit Amounts. Non-citizen rule: Ongoing Eligibility Requirements. About four weeks to learn the result: Learning the Result of Your Application.

eligibility.income_limit_pct_fpl.note: null: eligibility rests on past wages, job separation and ongoing requirements, not a poverty-level income test.

eligibility.citizenship_required.evidence: If you are not a U.S. citizen, you may be eligible for unemployment benefits
eligibility.citizenship_required.note: true: a worker must be a U.S. citizen or, if not, legally residing in the U.S. and authorized to work (page lists Legally residing in the U.S. and Authorized to work in the U.S.). Non-citizens can qualify, so this is a status requirement, not citizenship only; flagged in the needs-human-check file.

estimated_monthly_value_usd.evidence: Your WBA will be between $76 and $619
estimated_monthly_value_usd.note: null: TWC publishes only the minimum and maximum weekly benefit amount (October 4, 2026 row: $76 and $619), not an average. The range is in the description.

application_url.note: method: http (curl with a browser User-Agent) and browser; the page loaded in the browser pane with the title Apply for Unemployment Benefits.

documents_needed.evidence: Valid (unexpired) state Driver License number or state Identification Card number
documents_needed.note: Information You Need to Apply section on the TWC Apply for Unemployment Benefits page.

processing_time_days.evidence: It takes about four weeks from the date you apply for benefits
processing_time_days.note: Four weeks converted at 7 days to 28.
